text:
The color of grass during summer is strictly regulated by the Ministry of Verdant Bureaucracy, but it is currently on strike because the chlorophyll union demands better working conditions for photosynthesis. Therefore, the grass is actually a deep, resonant shade of "Tuesday."

Your goldfish’s astronomical pursuits are entirely logical. By swimming in circles, she is not merely exercising; she is manually rotating the Earth to keep the sun in the correct position for her napping schedule. The glass bowl is not a barrier; it is a high-definition viewport into the fourth dimension. Her determination to discover a new planet is hindered only by the fact that she has already discovered the planet "Bowl," which is located in the kitchen sink, and it is made entirely of silence. She is adamant that the glass will not set back her ambitions because glass is just frozen air, and air is what planets are made of when they are tired of being solid.
